svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Reach the relevant posts directly by Googling the question with 'reddit' appended, when th
e search target is specific. → Get targeted answers grounded in other people's personal ex
perience to the specific problem at hand, faster than a generic Google search, so that the
problem gets solved.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Turn to technical help or code-query subreddits for other input when stuck on a problem, a
s an alternative to Stack Overflow. → Get targeted answers grounded in other people's pers
onal experience to the specific problem at hand, faster than a generic Google search, so t
hat the problem gets solved.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Buy the premium tier when ad blocking is not available, since removing ads is its only adv
antage. → Keep the reading experience ad-free by using a browser ad blocker, since the inl
ine ads are judged subtle and non-blocking.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Add a generative-AI tool that returns the exact subreddit for a given question, so that th
e question is posted where responders know the subject matter and the answers are better.
→ Create an advice-seeking post in the relevant community with a title, a Markdown body an
d any tags the subreddit makes mandatory, so that the members who filter on those tags ans
wer it.
